name: NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides building management and operations services in Japan and the United States. The company also engages in security services; environmental facility management, including water supply, sewage treatment, and waste management and disposal facilities; residential management comprising managing condominiums, public housing, etc.; and real estate fund management businesses. In addition, it provides security; staffing; and payroll outsourcing and consulting services, as well as event planning and management, print design, bookbinding, and real estate finance. NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.
